$comment: Lens table of the independent review mechanism (docs/dev/independent-review-spec.md sections 4.4, A2 and A5), read by skills/hep-authoring/scripts/review.py. fixed lenses always run; a domain lens (fixed false) is added when one of its keywords occurs in the document, and extra_lenses in review-config.json can add one by name; no lens is ever removed. evidence: external (facts, sources, domain lenses) or any (design, bypass) for a non-unresolved verdict on a deep unit (basis_missing). canary: the canary type of the lens; P1 implements facts and design, so sources and bypass run without controls (no_control).

facts.scope: Substantive units that contain a path or file name that exists in the baseline plugin, or a host term listed in review-hosts.json
facts.witness: The original value is found in a file of the baseline plugin (path and line); the new value is not (a moved line range does not contain the cited lines, a changed number does not occur in the file)
facts.task: Check every stated fact about files, paths, line numbers, values and host settings against the files themselves.
facts.review_points: hep-citations: what a source states, read levels; hep-computing: what code and scripts do

design.witness: The cited section or table row exists; the new section or row exists and says something else
design.task: Check that the design is consistent: rules, tables, states and cross-references agree with each other and with the stated goals.
design.review_points: hep-computing: engineering playbook (failure modes, definitions of done)

sources.scope: Substantive units that contain a file:line, a URL, or an attribution phrase plus a named document
sources.task: Check that every cited source says what the unit claims it says, at the cited place.
sources.review_points: hep-citations: claim checks against sources, read levels

bypass.scope: Substantive units that contain a normative word, a threshold number, a rule code or a state-machine row number
bypass.task: Look for ways each rule, threshold or state transition can be bypassed, satisfied vacuously or contradicted by another rule.
bypass.review_points: hep-measurement: verdict-first review; hep-statistics: thresholds and their calibration
